learner: Bayesian logistic regression, diagonal Laplace posterior, prior N(0,1), per-row updates; act by Thompson sampling (scripts/policy/learn.py)

arms.source: the chip list Window U ships with the per-video question button; arm id = chip id
arms.now: no chips exist in src yet; the arms list fills when they do

context: where the chat opened (video page, home, metrics)
a video in view or not

kindToAdd.chip-shown: subject = chip id, meta = {position, propensity, surface, videoId?}
kindToAdd.chip-tap: subject = chip id, meta = {position, surface, videoId?}

logging.propensity: probability the sampled ordering showed that chip in that position

epochMarker.rule: No replay; every update is a live decision logged as above.

evaluation: Once 1,000 logged decisions exist: the standard protocol of docs/briefs/WINDOW-P2.md with the logged propensities in place of estimated ones (IPS is then unbiased), registered in the brief before the first fit.
